intro.title: Amethyst Bracelets
intro.descriptionHtml: Exquisite collection of beautiful Amethyst Bracelets with beads designed in various shapes and in combination with Rudraksha. Amethyst is a popular semi-precious gemstone, available in various shades of purple and violet. Amethyst heals and balances the Sahasrara/Crown Chakra which expands consciousness and awareness, enhances spiritual growth, improves memory, focus and bestows clarity of thoughts, helps to connect with Divine realm and brings other benefits of Amethyst.
